scope: manifest, file inventory, SHA256, paths, known credential patterns, size limits, supplied private identifiers, PDF objects/text/metadata, image metadata and OCR
publication_tool_controls: Exact inventory accepts clean package and rejects changed/missing/extra files
Private tokens rejected in UTF8, UTF16LE, UTF16BE, base64 and URL encoding
Metadata-free PDF accepted; author-bearing PDF rejected
Anonymous Git initialization resists inherited identity/config/signing/templates/hooks
archive_policy: Only file bytes are written to ZIP; neutral timestamps and modes; no xattrs, owner IDs, resource forks, archive comments or extra fields. Local filesystem xattrs are not a public deliverable.
limits: Does not guarantee anonymity of distinctive content, prior disclosures, account activity, or later edits. PDF image pixels are not OCR-scanned; image-only pages without extracted text are rejected.
independent_audit: Separate read-only audit confirmed content/metadata/known-identifier checks, 31 nonpersonal source links, and inclusion of four later research files. This is not external peer review.
